questions.context: You see this notice on an English-language website for teenagers.
questions.announcement: Reviews wanted: the best place in town to have a great time.
questions.question: Is there a place in your town where young people love to spend time – a sports centre, a park, a café or somewhere else? Write a review of it. Describe the place, say what you can do there and explain why it is a good place to go with friends.
